assets.alt_text: Honey bees in rapid flight and clustered at a hive entrance during a documented episode of intense robbing
assets.caption: Still from a documented intense-robbing event. Heavy entrance traffic alone is not diagnostic; fighting, irregular approaches, attempts at cracks and rapid store loss provide the behavioural context.
assets.credit: Frame extracted from Peck & Seeley (2019), PLOS ONE S1 Video, CC BY 4.0.
assets.diagnostic_boundary: Static entrance traffic alone does not distinguish robbing from orientation or normal flight.
